siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cenador de Amós
siblings.summary: Jardines Villaverde is literally next door to Cenador de Amós — book it. Three other rural posadas sit within a 15-minute walk if it's full.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cenador de Amós
siblings.summary: Nine palaces, casonas and posadas within a 25-km / ≈€45 night-taxi radius of Cenador de Amós — ranked by distance and character.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Cenador de Amós
siblings.summary: Slim but real tech scene in a 30 km radius — ACEDE 2026 (AI/business) and TAEE 2026 (electronics) anchor the calendar.

sources.title: Centro Botín — visitor info
sources.claim: Centro Botín hours: Oct–May Tue–Fri 10:00–14:00 / 16:00–20:00, weekends 10:00–20:00; Jun–Sep Tue–Sun 10:00–21:00.

sources.title: Centro Botín — 2026 exhibitions
sources.claim: Spring 2026 programme: ITINERARIOS XXX and Point and Counterpoint until 19 Apr; Yuko Mohri: Entanglements 28 Mar – 6 Sep.

sources.title: Centro Botín — admission prices
sources.claim: General admission €9 online (€10 door), €5 concession, free under 18.

sources.title: Magdalena tourist train
sources.claim: Magdalena tourist train: 10:00–19:00 summer, 10:00–14:00 / 15:30–18:00 winter, every 15–20 min.

sources.title: Palacio de la Magdalena
sources.claim: Magdalena Palace interior typically open weekends only.

sources.title: Magdalena mini-zoo
sources.claim: Free mini-zoo of seals, sea lions and penguins; feeding around 13:00.

sources.title: El Sardinero (Santander tourism)
sources.claim: El Sardinero is Santander's longest beach (~1,300 m), split into First and Second.

sources.title: Gran Casino del Sardinero
sources.claim: Gran Casino del Sardinero — 1916 Belle Époque building.

sources.title: Mercado de la Esperanza
sources.claim: 19th-c. cast-iron food hall behind the town hall, fish below / meat above.

sources.title: Mercado de la Esperanza — opening hours
Audiala — Centro Botín
sources.claim: Renzo Piano's barnacle-on-stilts art centre on the bay.

sources.title: Escuela Cántabra de Surf
sources.claim: Europe's best-known surf school, on the Somo beachfront.

sources.title: Federación Cántabra de Surf
sources.claim: Ribamontán al Mar — Spain's first natural surf reserve.

sources.title: Playa de Los Locos
sources.claim: Suances, ~31 km west — Natural Surf Reserve with three named peaks.

sources.title: Parque de Cabárceno — visit planning
sources.claim: Cabárceno opens 09:30; closes 17:00–20:00 by season.

sources.title: Cabárceno (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: 750 ha reclaimed open-pit iron mine, opened 1989, 100+ species in semi-free-range enclosures.

sources.title: Cabárceno trip report
sources.claim: Brown bears in 35 ha, biggest captive African elephant herd outside Africa, gorillas, tigers, lions, jaguars. Plan 4½–5 hours.

sources.title: Peña Cabarga new mirador
sources.claim: March 2026: 38.31 m Monumento al Indiano gains a glass-walled upper mirador with 10° outward tilt.

sources.title: Peña Cabarga viewpoint
sources.claim: Free ecobús shuttle links Peña Cabarga with Cabárceno.

sources.title: Pueblos más bonitos — Liérganes
sources.claim: Liérganes — Conjunto Histórico-Artístico of 17th–18th-c. stone casonas.

sources.title: Balneario de Liérganes
sources.claim: Sulphurated mineral waters from Santa Fuente spring, 3-ha park, runs Mar–Dec, B&B from ~€48.

sources.title: El Plural — Liérganes
sources.claim: Four-century-old spa, birthplace of the 'hombre pez' legend.

sources.title: Laredo (spain.info)
sources.claim: Laredo's Puebla Vieja — medieval Historic-Artistic Site with the Gothic Santa María de la Asunción.

sources.title: Laredo (Turismo de Cantabria)
sources.claim: Puebla Vieja declared Historic-Artistic Site 1970; modern marina with 850+ moorings.

sources.title: Anchoas de Santoña — what to see
sources.claim: Santoña anchovy capital + Santoña Marshes Natural Reserve at the Asón mouth.

sources.title: Faro del Caballo — 700 steps
sources.claim: 763 stairs originally built by 19th-c. prison inmates, rebuilt 2013.

sources.title: Liérganes — Mi Ruta
sources.claim: 16th-c. Renaissance Puente Mayor over the Miera, Hombre Pez statue, Casa de los Cañones.

sources.title: Pedreña — legend of Seve
sources.claim: Seve debuted as caddie at Real Golf de Pedreña aged 9.

sources.title: Severiano Ballesteros — Pedreña
sources.claim: Seve statue at village entrance; bronze fist-pump from 1984 Open.

sources.title: Santillana del Mar
sources.claim: Traffic-free medieval town anchored by 12th-c. Colegiata de Santa Juliana.

sources.title: Santillana del Mar (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: Altamira Museum's replica neocave (original UNESCO cave closed).

sources.title: Conservas El Capricho
sources.claim: Santoña family business; 12–18 mo hand maturation.

sources.title: Conservas Catalina
sources.claim: Hand-massaged Santoña anchovies, min. 1-year brine.

sources.title: Conservas 5Ñ tour info
sources.claim: 30-min Santoña factory tour with tasting: €7 adult / €4 child.

sources.title: Conservas Avelina visits
sources.claim: Free guided visit with tasting Mon–Thu 11:00 / 12:00 / 13:00.

sources.title: La Bodega del Riojano
sources.claim: Historic cellar with Museo Redondo of 60+ hand-painted barrel tops; Michelin mention.

sources.title: Casa Lita
sources.claim: Port-front pintxos at ~€2.70 each; monthly special sells out.

sources.title: La Caseta de Bombas
sources.claim: 1908 building on the Gamazo dock; buys daily at the Santander fish auction.

sources.title: Sobaos Joselín (Selaya)
sources.claim: 40-min museum visit with free tasting + 2-h hands-on bake workshop.

sources.title: Sobaos Etelvina Sañudo
sources.claim: IGP sobaos and quesadas, 100% butter, no preservatives.

sources.title: Sidrería El Molino de la Hoz
sources.claim: Cordero a la estaca with Sidra Somarroza in Penagos.

sources.title: Sidra Somarroza
sources.claim: Cantabrian natural cider — the indigenous alternative to Asturian cider.

sources.title: Sidrería El Pegollu
sources.claim: Asturian-style chigre inside the Centro Asturiano in Santander.

sources.title: Asador Itxaski
sources.claim: Grilled fish and seafood at Pedreña port, own fish-market supply.

sources.title: Restaurante Marina (Pedreña)
sources.claim: Pedreña-port arroz con nécoras — rustic harbour-front alternative.

sources.title: Escuela Cántabra de Surf — lessons
sources.claim: Group lessons 2 h, all kit included; from age 5. €35 single / €99 3-day / €160 5-day.

sources.title: Real Golf de Pedreña — tariffs
sources.claim: Real Golf de Pedreña 2026: €70 low-season weekday guest → €350 high-season federated. Handicap required.

sources.title: Real Golf de Pedreña (Golf in Spain)
sources.claim: Colt 1928 design + Seve 1991 extension. Max HCP 27 men / 35 women.

sources.title: Golf Santa Marina
sources.claim: Seve-designed, inaugurated 2001 (further west, ~50 km). €60–€72.

sources.title: Los Reginas ferry — schedule
sources.claim: Los Reginas: Santander–Pedreña–Somo ferry 365 days/year, every ~30 min, €4 one-way / €6.50 return.

sources.title: Faro del Caballo — summer 2026 closure
sources.claim: Faro del Caballo staircase closed throughout summer 2026 — rockfall risk ~20 m above the steps.

sources.title: Monte Buciero loop (AllTrails)
sources.claim: Wider 9.5 km Buciero loop (~3 h, moderate) remains open as substitute.

sources.title: Stand Up Santander
sources.claim: Guided kayak and SUP from Playa de los Peligros: €30 pp, 1.5–2 h, kit & insurance included.

sources.title: Costa Quebrada Geopark
sources.claim: 15 km of vertical Cretaceous flysch ridges, sea stacks and arches.

sources.title: Costa Quebrada PR-S 3 (Picuco)
sources.claim: PR-S 3 flagship coast walk; popular Canallave–Madero–Somocuevas loop ~6 km / 1 h 36 min.

sources.title: GR-74 Corredor Oriental
sources.claim: GR-74 long-distance trail crossing the Pasiego valleys.

sources.title: Peña Cabarga (AllTrails)
sources.claim: Peña Cabarga summit climb — 7.2 mi out-and-back, ~600 m gain.

sources.title: Plea Loredo — horse riding
sources.claim: Horseback lessons and beach rides on Somo–Loredo sands.

sources.title: Cantabria Vías Verdes
sources.claim: Santander–Astillero and Miera-valley greenways — flat family cycling.

sources.title: Fuertes de Santoña (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: Three fortifications on Monte Buciero: San Carlos (17th c.), San Martín, and Fuerte del Mazo / Napoleón.

sources.title: Playa de La Salvé
sources.claim: Cantabria's longest beach: shell-shaped 4,250 m sweep sheltered by Monte Buciero.

sources.title: Cabaña pasiega
sources.claim: Vernacular stone cattle hut of the Pas valleys; ~10,000 built 18th–19th c.
